title: Janu Shirshasana C
notes: Janu Shirshasana can be practiced by anyone, man or woman, irrespective of age or sex.

sequence.action: Arms up, palms together, gaze at the fingertips
Fold forward, hands beside the feet, nose to the knees
Lift the head
Jump back: Chaturanga Dandasana
Urdhva Mukha Svanasana
Adho Mukha Svanasana

Jump through and sit, stretch the left leg out straight, bring the right foot in toward the groin, twisting it so that the toes are pressed to the floor and the heel is pointing up toward the navel, press the right knee forward to a 45 degree angle, take hold of the left foot with both hands, straighten the back and arms, and tighten the anus and lower abdomen.
Folding at the waist, place the forehead or chin on the outstretched leg, press the right heel into the navel, and do puraka and rechaka as much as possible.
Lift the head and straighten the arms.
Cross the legs and lift up on the hands (Uth Pluthi)
Jump back: Chaturanga Dandasana
Urdhva Mukha Svanasana
Adho Mukha Svanasana
Other side: right leg out, left foot turned with the heel toward the navel; hold the foot
Other side: forehead or chin to the leg, heel into the navel
Other side: lift the head, straighten the arms
Cross the legs and lift up on the hands (Uth Pluthi)
Jump back: Chaturanga Dandasana
Urdhva Mukha Svanasana
Adho Mukha Svanasana
Jump the feet between the hands, lift the head
Fold, nose to the knees
Urdhva Hastasana: arms up, hands together, look at the fingertips
Samasthiti

benefits: Janu Shirshasana cures maladies such as muthra krcchra [burning while urinating], dhatu krcchra [semen loss], and diabetes.
Janu Shirshasana destroys these terrible afflictions, and purifies and strengthens the nadi known as sivani, which is related to the dhatu.
Janu Shirshasana (A & B) press on the virya nala for men, and Janu Shirshasana (C) presses on it for women, though all three are necessary and useful for both men and women alike.
In this way, diseases of the type just described will be cured, the fire of hunger increased, and food digested easily.
quotes: By practicing Janu Shirshasana, the dhatu strengthens and, gradually, the vasana of kama [the tendency to desire] is destroyed.
benefits_source: Given for all three types of Janu Shirshasana.
